question: How many cities are covered under the Atal Mission for Rejuvenation and Urban Transformation (AMRUT) scheme?
solution:
The correct answer is __**500**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• The Atal Mission for Rejuvenation and Urban Transformation (AMRUT) scheme** covered 500 Cities and towns**** across India**. 
 
• These cities are **selected based on their population** and other criteria.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The AMRUT **scheme aims to enhance the quality of life** in urban areas by focusing on essential infrastructure and services
 
• It** primarily targets water supply, sewerage, and urban green spaces. **
 
• The scheme also emphasizes **reducing pollution**
 
 
• **​** By encouraging the use of **public transport** or **non-motorized transport**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Atal Mission for Rejuvenation and Urban Transformation (AMRUT) scheme was **launched on ****June 25, 2015**
 
• Launched by** ****Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs**
 
• **Phase 2.0 Launched on **October 1, 2021
 
• AMRUT has provided **134 lakh water tap connections** and **102 lakh sewer connections.**
